description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the PayGradeDao within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods that verify the functionality of CRUD operations and data retrieval methods related to pay grades and associated currencies. The test class interacts with database fixtures to ensure correct behavior of data access object methods.

classes.name: PayGradeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the PayGradeDao data access object, verifying CRUD operations and data retrieval related to pay grades and currencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by instantiating PayGradeDao, setting up fixture files, and populating test data.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeList
methods.description: Verifies that fetching the list of pay grades returns expected results, including count and names.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeById
methods.description: Checks that retrieving a pay grade by ID returns the correct pay grade with the expected name.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyListByPayGradeId
methods.description: Tests fetching the list of currencies for a specific pay grade, validating count and specific currency IDs.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyByCurrencyIdAndPayGradeId
methods.description: Validates retrieval of a currency by its ID and associated pay grade ID, checking minimum salary attribute.

methods.name: testGetPayPeriods
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all pay periods, checking total count and specific names.

methods.name: testGetCurrencies
methods.description: Verifies the list of all available currencies, including count and specific IDs.

methods.name: testGetCurrencyById
methods.description: Checks fetching a currency by ID yields correct code and name.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyListCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of pay grade currencies for a specific pay grade.

methods.name: testGetPayGradeCurrencyList
methods.description: Verifies fetching the list of pay grade currencies for a certain pay grade, validating currency IDs.

methods.name: testGetPayGradesCount
methods.description: Checks that counting pay grades returns the correct total.

methods.name: testSavePayGrade
methods.description: Verifies that saving a new pay grade results in a PayGrade object being returned.

methods.name: testSavePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Tests saving a new pay grade currency association and checks for a PayGradeCurrency object.

methods.name: testDeletePayGrades
methods.description: Ensures that deleting pay grades by IDs returns the correct count of deleted items.

methods.name: testDeletePayGradeCurrency
methods.description: Verifies that deleting pay grade currencies by pay grade ID and currency IDs returns correct count.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrencies
methods.description: Checks retrieving allowed pay currencies for a pay grade returns expected number and IDs.

methods.name: testGetAllowedPayCurrenciesCount
methods.description: Verifies count of allowed pay currencies for a pay grade.
